segments.text: You open a codebase you've never seen.
Ask your coding agent: slash tour, how does login work?
It studies the code, and finds the route through it.
A tour map: the whole answer.
Each box leads to its step.
Step by step, the right file opens.
The exact lines light up, explained right under the code.
Go deeper, and the Path shows where you are.
Pin a tour to Start here, for every newcomer.
Export any tour as a page, for Confluence, Notion, or your wiki.
Your editor. Your agent. Even your notebooks.
Understand any codebase, one step at a time.
